# VeriWorkly Documentation & API Reference
> Technical documentation, architecture guides, and interactive API reference for VeriWorkly — the privacy-first career workspace.

## Documentation Overview
VeriWorkly Docs (`docs.veriworkly.com`) is built on Fumadocs and serves as the single source of truth for developer integrations, system architecture, data models, and API specifications.

Two content trees:
- `/docs` — hand-written product, architecture, operations, and contribution guides.
- `/api-reference` — generated from the OpenAPI specification; never edited by hand.

## Machine-Readable Resources
- **Agent Card**: `https://docs.veriworkly.com/.well-known/agent.json`
- **OpenAPI 3.1 Spec (JSON)**: `https://docs.veriworkly.com/openapi.json`
- **OpenAPI 3.1 Spec (YAML)**: `https://docs.veriworkly.com/openapi.yaml`
- **Interactive API Reference**: `https://docs.veriworkly.com/api-reference`
- **Pricing**: `https://docs.veriworkly.com/pricing.md`

## API Authentication & Response Specifications

Base URL: `https://api.veriworkly.com/api/v1` (local development: `http://localhost:8080/api/v1`).

### Authentication Schemes
1. **API Keys** (`vw_` prefix + 64 hex characters): send via `X-API-Key: vw_...` or `Authorization: Bearer vw_...`. Both headers are accepted.
   - *Rate limit*: 20 requests per 15-minute window per key by default, configurable per key up to 600.
   - *Allowed scopes*: `user:read`, `user:write`, `resume:read`, `resume:write`, `roadmap:read`, `changelog:read`, `github:read`, `ai:write`. A key missing a route's required scope receives `403`.
2. **Session Cookies**: Better Auth HTTP-only cookie, named `veriworkly-auth.session_token` locally and `__Secure-veriworkly-auth.session_token` in production. Honoured only for whitelisted first-party origins.

Only `GET /health` and `GET /health/ready` are open to unauthenticated callers. Endpoints described as "public" — public portfolios, public share links, roadmap, changelog, GitHub stats — need no logged-in user but still require an API key or a whitelisted first-party origin, and return `401` without one.

### Standard Response Envelope
Every `/api/v1` endpoint returns a standardized JSON envelope:
- **Success**: `{ "success": true, "message": "...", "data": { ... } }`
- **Error**: `{ "success": false, "message": "...", "statusCode": 4xx|5xx, "details": [ ... ] }` — `details` is present only for validation errors.

Endpoints under `/api/v1/auth/*` are served by Better Auth and return **its** payload shapes, not this envelope.

### Pagination
List endpoints use offset pagination. Page size defaults to 20 and is capped at 50, addressable as either `limit`/`offset` or `page`/`pageSize`; responses echo both alongside `total`, `totalPages`, `hasMore`, and a `pagination` block. `nextCursor` is always `null`.

## API Directory (72 paths, 78 operations, 152 schemas, 18 tags)
- **Health**: `GET /health`, `GET /health/ready`
- **Authentication**: `POST /auth/email-otp/send-verification-otp`, `POST /auth/sign-in/email-otp`, `GET /auth/get-session`, `POST /auth/sign-out`
- **API Keys**: `GET /api-keys`, `POST /api-keys`, `GET /api-keys/{id}`, `DELETE /api-keys/{id}`, `POST /api-keys/{id}/rotate`, `POST /api-keys/{id}/revoke`
- **Users**: `GET /users/me`, `PUT /users/me/name`, `PUT /users/me/username`, `PUT /users/me/sync`, `GET /users/{username}/availability`
- **Profile**: `GET /profiles/master`, `PUT /profiles/master` (full replacement, not a patch)
- **Profile Import**: `GET /profiles/import/quota`, `POST /profiles/import/github`, `POST /profiles/import/linkedin`
- **Documents**: `GET /documents`, `POST /documents`, `GET /documents/{id}`, `PATCH /documents/{id}`, `DELETE /documents/{id}`
- **Shares**: `POST /shares`, `GET /shares/documents/shared-ids`, `GET /shares/documents/{documentId}`, `DELETE /shares/documents/{documentId}/links/{shareLinkId}`, `GET /shares/public/{username}/{slug}`, `POST /shares/public/{username}/{slug}/verify`
- **ATS**: `GET /ats/quota`, `POST /ats/extract`, `POST /ats/check`, `POST /ats/analyze`, `POST /ats/convert-resume`
- **AI**: `GET /ai/actions`, `POST /ai/generate`
- **Portfolios**: `GET /portfolios/public`, `GET /portfolios/public/{subdomain}`, `POST /portfolios/public/{subdomain}/view`, `GET /portfolios/me`, `PUT /portfolios/draft`, `GET /portfolios/subdomains/{slug}/availability`, `GET /portfolios/preview/{documentId}`, `POST /portfolios/publish`, `POST /portfolios/unpublish`, `GET /portfolios/analytics`
- **Portfolio Assets**: `POST /portfolio-assets/upload-url`, `POST /portfolio-assets/complete`, `DELETE /portfolio-assets/{id}`
- **Billing**: `GET /billing/me`, `GET /billing/history`, `GET /billing/credits`, `GET /billing/credits/history`, `POST /billing/checkout`, `POST /billing/checkout/cancel`, `POST /billing/portal`, `POST /billing/credits/checkout`
- **Affiliates**: `POST /affiliates/click`, `GET /affiliates/leaderboard`, `GET /affiliates/me`, `POST /affiliates/enroll`, `POST /affiliates/referral`, `POST /affiliates/withdrawals`
- **Ambassador**: `GET /ambassador/me`, `POST /ambassador/apply`
- **Roadmap**: `GET /roadmap`, `GET /roadmap/stats`, `GET /roadmap/{id}`
- **Changelog**: `GET /changelog`, `GET /changelog/stats`, `GET /changelog/{id}`
- **GitHub**: `GET /github/stats`, `GET /github/issues`, `POST /github/admin/sync` (admin only)

Not part of this reference: `/api/v1/admin/*` (admin console), `/api/v1/stats/admin/*` (admin telemetry dashboard), `/api/v1/contact` (contact form intake), and `/api/v1/stats/events` (telemetry ingress) are internal surfaces.

## Key Product Facts
- Documents are stored in the browser's `localStorage` first. Cloud sync requires an account and is opt-in per account and per document.
- All six export formats (PDF, DOCX, HTML, Markdown, plain text, JSON) are generated client-side. There is no headless browser and no server-side render step.
- Seven resume templates and five cover letter templates, all free. The four portfolio templates live in a private submodule; two of them are premium.
- Payments run through Dodo Payments. VeriWorkly does not use Stripe.
- The application code is MIT-licensed: `https://github.com/VeriWorkly/veriworkly`
